about: Behaviour-neutral edits the BlastModel split makes beyond moving code, adding imports and widening access. Each edit replaces text that must occur exactly once in its file; Scripts/split/split-blastmodel.sh applies them first (skipping any already applied) and fails if one no longer matches. Pass --no-seams to leave them out, and what depends on them stays in BlastCore.

seams.why: IFCStructure's and ShellMesh's initialisers read ShellSolver.fibresAcross, a constant on the GPU shell solver, which keeps IFCStructure in BlastCore and with it ImportedModel, Scenario, StructureModel and about 85 other plain declarations. The constant (9 points through a wall's thickness) moves to ShellMesh, which moves; ShellSolver.fibresAcross stays as an alias of it, so the solver and the tests read the same 9.

edits.old:
/// connection is evaluated, from face to face.
    static let fibresAcross = 9
edits.new:
/// connection is evaluated, from face to face (`ShellMesh.fibresAcross`).
    static let fibresAcross = ShellMesh.fibresAcross
